caption: One AI click wrote 8 questions in about 34 seconds, including a follow up for scores below 3. On Free every respondent sees that follow up, because logic starts on Basic.
Results after 3 test answers on Free: 100% completion and 18 seconds on average. Filter, Compare by, Variables and Email report are locked to paid plans.
The AI summary gets the numbers right, 3.7 out of 5 and an NPS of 33, but labels the open answers 100% negative while calling the feedback generally positive.
On Free the only export is CSV with raw data. PDF, PowerPoint, Excel, SPSS and R are locked. Nothing was downloaded.
Annual billing brings Basic to $7, Pro to $23 and Business to $63 a month, against $9, $29 and $79 monthly. The offer box gives 33% off monthly plans for the first 3 months until 31 December.
